subject: Next steps: Identity & Access controls and evidence items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: IAM items and next steps

Hi Dana / Chris — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Call highlights:
- Primary drivers: reduce admin overhead for user provisioning, ensure strict role boundaries for clinicians, and confirm HIPAA controls for PHI access.
- Current ask from MedSecure: SOC 2 evidence timeline, BAA/hipaa scope, and specific IAM artifacts (SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, RBAC matrix, admin separation controls).

Immediate asks (what we need from MedSecure):
1) Complete the vendor security questionnaire we sent (link below) — this helps us prioritize the evidence items.
2) Provide a sample user attribute mapping for SCIM (examples: emp_id, email, role) if you have one — will speed integration.
3) Confirm whether you prefer Redwood-managed SSO (hosted metadata) or if you will host an IdP and provide metadata.

What Redwood will provide this week:
- IAM evidence checklist (attached) that maps requested items to our artifacts and expected delivery windows.
- A short SCIM mapping template to use as an example.
- Answers on SOC 2 and BAA scope from security (cc: Neha).

Attachments: IAM-evidence-checklist.xlsx (checklist), redwood-security-FAQ.pdf (FAQ)

Proposed next steps:
- Dana: complete the questionnaire by EOD Thursday if possible.
- MedSecure: attach a sample SCIM mapping or confirm attribute expectations.
- Vivek/Neha: I'll loop you for any technical/security clarifications; Neha will follow up on SOC 2/BAA specifics.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-minute follow-up for next week to review the checklist and align on timelines.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: IAM items and next steps

Thanks Jordan — this is helpful. A few quick items from our side:
- We’ll aim to complete the questionnaire by Thursday.
- For SCIM: we currently send these attributes from our IdP: givenName, familyName, email, employeeNumber, managerEmail, and a custom attribute role_code. I’ll attach our example mapping in my reply if that helps.
- HIPAA/BAA: we need a sample BAA to share with our legal team.
- SOC 2: we’re mostly interested in controls around logical access, admin separation, and change management; a high-level status update will do for now.

Question: do you support scoped admin roles for customer orgs (i.e., can we limit admin rights to certain projects/environments)?

On the questionnaire: I've attached our internal vendor questionnaire (medsecure-vendor-questionnaire.pdf) — please confirm which items on your checklist map to it so we can crosswalk.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Lopez | Director, IT Security | MedSecure Health

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: IAM items and next steps — security answers

Hi Dana / Jordan — looping in answers from Security & Compliance. Short answers first, details below.

Summary:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025; Type II audit is in progress with an expected report delivery in Q3 2026. We can share the Type I report now and provide the Type II once finalized.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-boundary deployments — we have a standard BAA template and support Private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) if customers need stricter controls. I’ll attach the BAA template and BAA process note.
- SSO/SAML: We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. We can host SAML metadata (when customers prefer Redwood-managed certs) or accept your IdP metadata.
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for provisioning + deprovisioning. I’ve attached a SCIM mapping template (SCIM-mapping-template.csv).
- RBAC/admin controls: We provide tenant-level RBAC with customizable roles. Customers can scope admin privileges to projects or environments; detailed role matrix exports are available for audits.

Mapping to your questionnaire:
- Logical access controls: see checklist rows 5–8 (we’ll mark these in the shared checklist).
- Admin separation: we can provide screenshots and an exportable CSV of admin roles for auditors.
- Change management: we can provide our change control policy excerpt and recent change logs for the relevant services.

Attachments: SCIM-mapping-template.csv, (BAA-template.pdf — to be shared by Legal in separate email), redwood-security-FAQ.pdf (already shared)

If you’d like, Vivek can set up a short technical call to walk through the SCIM example and SAML metadata exchange. Jordan — I can also coordinate secure transfer of any artifacts to your preferred method (SFTP / secure Drive link / DocuSign for signed BAA).

-Neha
